description: Renders one of Development's email templates (sign-in, purchase, plan-start, notify, notify-account, notify-event, email-person, inbox-reply) with sample data — the saved version, or, with html, that design instead (to check it before saving with put_email_template). Answers the subject and the plain-text part, and which {{vars}} Gemmein stripped as unknown; never the rendered HTML itself (a chat has no browser to show it in — put_email_template saves the design, and the dashboard's Email room shows it rendered). usesPlainDesign true means nothing is saved yet: the preview is Gemmein's own plain design, not this template. Changes nothing. This is what a founder may call checking what an email looks like.

html.description: optional: preview this HTML instead of the saved version

name: dev_email_template_preview
title: Preview an email template
